turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. I can see why such a matter would require the utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I see that I must indeed reveal myself. Let us proceed with the utmost confidentiality, as the stakes are incredibly high.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us have the details, Your Majesty. Every fact is of importance in such matters.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall disclose all that I know, trusting in your wisdom and discretion. The matter at hand involves a matter of the heart, intertwined with political ramifications that could affect the future of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am at your disposal, Your Majesty, and will do my best to assist in this delicate matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us proceed, then. I require a detailed account of the situation, starting from the beginning.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, let us begin. As you know, I am beset by a situation that threatens not only my personal happiness but also the stability of my kingdom. It involves a matter of a delicate nature, concerning a person close to my heart and the political intrigues surrounding our royal house.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand the gravity of the situation, Your Majesty. Please proceed with your account, and rest assured that we will handle this matter with the utmost care.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Commence with your narrative, Your Majesty. I assure you that my attention is entirely focused upon your case.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, please feel free to speak without reserve. We are here to ensure your concerns are addressed with the confidentiality they deserve.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall commence, then. However, I must reiterate the utmost importance of secrecy in this matter. Should any detail be leaked, the consequences could be dire for all involved.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. I shall maintain the strictest confidentiality. Proceed with your narrative.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall begin, then. My name is Wilhelm Gottlieb, Count von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. The matter at hand involves a personal matter of the highest importance, which could have significant political ramifications for my homeland.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand the gravity of Your Majesty's situation and assure you that Doctor Holmes and I will do everything in our power to assist.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am aware of the delicate nature of this matter, and I shall proceed with caution. It involves a personal issue that has political undertones and could affect the stability of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I understand the sensitivity of the situation, Your Majesty. Please proceed with your narrative when you are ready.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must ask for your utmost discretion and secrecy in this matter. It involves a matter of personal and political significance that I dare not speak of lightly.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I can assure you that both Doctor Holmes and I value the importance of discretion in such matters.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have a great deal at stake, and the slightest indiscretion could lead to grave consequences for my realm and myself. I trust that you will be discreet.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I give you my word that the information you share will be treated with the utmost confidentiality. Please proceed when you are comfortable.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
